Episode counter doesn’t update. I’m using the Bible in a Year feature. The times when I’d like to listen to several episodes in a row, the app doesn’t mark the second onwards as done, so there’s no seamless continuity. This seems to also be true of those topics that are divvied into many episodes. Very frustrating.

Secondarily, I started listening to a talk on Ignatian prayer that was divided into 30 episodes. It’s so broken up that it’s impossible to listen to. Really bad idea to break up this talk in this manner.
Great app. I enjoy this app would love to have Bible in a Year in Spanish. Would also enjoy more Spanish content.
Great Resource!. For a free resource, this app is insane.

Readings. I appreciate hearing the daily readings on this app
Amen. My favorite app.
Amazing. Great game. Includes everything I was looking for, including all free services.

Gets right to the point. I used Hallow for the past two years but it had started to take on a bit of a celebrity feel to it, which was a turn-off. I wanted a prayer app that would be more focused on prayer and scripture and less about filler and fluff. Amen has been exactly what I hoped it would be. You can favorite the prayers that move you the most. They have daily scripture readings, daily theology, daily rosary, etc. I love the music and sound backgrounds available (I use choral chants as my go-to) and that you can pause prayers if you need more time. And I like that they don’t waste a lot of time with introductory greetings and setup for each piece of audio - that was becoming a time waster on Hallow. Overall an excellent, streamlined alternative to Hallow.
Daily!. It’s the only app I use daily for sure. Thank you and may God keep blessing you, for many to be blessed in return through your efforts.

Best App for Prayer & Reflection. I'm absolutely loving this app! It's been a game-changer for my spiritual practice. With this app, I can easily stay on top of my daily prayers, novenas, Bible readings, and meditation. The organization is intuitive, making it simple to access daily readings, pray the rosary, or find guided meditations for special seasons like Lent and Advent. Plus, the spiritual sleep stories are a wonderful way to wind down. I highly recommend this app to anyone looking to deepen their faith and spiritual practice!
Great resource. The Amen application helps you draw closer to God each and everyday. Readings, reflections, prays, even spiritual music to help set the tone.

Peace. Loving the Amen App. Thank you to the Augustine Institute for this offering. I use the free App for the daily Mass readings and Dr Grey’s reflections. There is so much to offer, seek and you shall find. 🙏
Closed captioning. Enjoy this app. Closed captions would make it so much easier. Often I don’t understand the words, so I listen to a different app that has CC. Thanks

My FAVORITE. This app has been an absolute blessing in my life!!! It keeps me aligned, motivated, and in tune!!! Beyond grateful for all of it, and I absolutely love the daily guided rosary!!! It’s all wonderful and has been a supernatural conduit in my life and do not want to go a day without it!!! 🩵🙏🏼🕊️
Amen!. Use it every day!
Wonderful. I use this app often. It’s very helpful as I am a convert and am still learning.
Beautiful find. Love that I found this app. Im doing the bible in a year. The sleep stories are wonderful. Daily prayers bring me peace joy strength and much love. Thank you AMEN
Blessing to Build Your Faith. D. Argenti
The Best. Make this the first and last app you open each and everyday.
Wonderful App. This app is like a breath of fresh air. I like the simplicity and the music/sound options but I also love all the resources and appreciate that it’s all free.

The daily reflections. Each morning as I make my coffee, I look forward to hearing three passages from scripture and being challenged as to how they can work in my life that I might be a blessing to others. 
Thank you so much✝️
Rejoice always, always, pray ceasing, give thanks and all things, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Love it!!!. What a wonderful app!! I thank God for it. Midnight contribute what I can to help them continue their efforts.

Keep up the great work Augustine Institute. I have an affinity and devotion to Saint Augustine. The Augustine Institute does great work. I am a mission circle member. They have everything from daily reflections to graduate level study. They even offer on campus retreats.

🙏🏼. The best FREE download

Must have!. This app is a must have. I use it more than once a day. It has been such a blessing to me and my journey. The only thing I would change is putting subtitles so we can read along.

I sometimes don’t attend mass daily but I always use this app to hear and reflect on the sacred words of the letters, psalms and gospel . My Lord is always with me …

Daily dose of spirituality. I cannot express in words the gratitude and appreciation for this app. Thank you all who contribute to this amazing place I come to daily for prayer, contemplation and lectio divino. The rosary with Mike scherlight and Teresa, the daily mass readings, novenas and so much more. Ali with soul enriching content - thank you.

Blessing to me and my family. It is a blessing. I listen daily to the day’s readings and reflection. I enjoy praying the rosary and novenas. I feel it has increased my love and strengthened my faith for God.

Favorite app. I think this is my favorite app of all time. The content and the price are awesome. I spend time thinking fondly of the stories and lessons on here. I appreciate the work that went into making this what it is. Thank you!
Closer. This app’s bring me closer to our maker and provides clarity encouragement to my daily life
THE Catholic / Christian App. The best app! I love the background music and art. Just a beautiful app. The developers should be proud. God bless you for this app.

Need subtitles. I love this app. However I have a hearing disability and would greatly appreciate if you could add subtitles, especially to the prayers. That would make it more user friendly for people like me who have processing disorders. Thank you!
Mrs C Blanco. I have been using and enjoying the Amen App for several years. All the material has helped me grow closer to God and strengthened my faith.
Best catholic bible app. Very good content and presentation. God bless you.

Praise Be. I have used this app for two years now. Praying is the best way to start my day. Tim Gray is a blessing to listen to and I also benefit greatly from the sleep stories. A particular memory stays with me… I used a healing prayer from here to pray over my 92 year old mom who fell. She turned the corner and regained her ability to walk. Praise be. 🙏🏼
Gracias a Dios. I like it, wish it were in Spanish unless idk how to change the settings.

Good Christian app. I love the Bible in a Year series on this app. I like that it is just the Bible being read without commentary, so I can simply become familiar with God’s Word and have space to meditate on it on my own. For some reason I get easily annoyed by voices of podcasters, audible readers, etc. And this narrator did not annoy me.

I hope someday they might post the Bible in a Year audio on their website, YouTube, or Spotify so I can also listen without my smartphone. But I really love this app. The aesthetic feels reverent, traditional, and warm to me. Love the option of music or ambient sounds in the background and the ability to adjust the volume of it independently from the meditation. This is my favorite Christian app.

An excellent resource for prayer. I particularly enjoy the daily mass reading and the meditation that follows. This app is informative, inspiring and uplifting. It truly is an asset for anyone who wishes to find comfort and grow stronger in their faith. Thank you, sincerely

Awesome Resource. I use the app everyday for the daily Mass readings and other prayers. It’s an awesome resource, and it’s free too! God bless the Augustine Institute for providing this to the public for free. I intend to be a donor and support their work. Thank you!
Amazing. This is such an amazing and beautiful app. I feel the presence of the Lord and a healing throughout my soul. Words cannot express the gratitude I feel in finding this app…thank you

I have done the Bible in Year several times but each time that I did it, I gain ed more knowledge. 
Thanks to all who contribute in putting out such great works, books , stories, videos and music.
May God continue to bless you all with the wisdom, grace and knowledge to continue God’s work.
Norma Jean. This Amen app has been a saving grace in our home. Our family prayer, nighttime rituals and times of uncertainties we pleat something that grounds us affirms our faith.

My journey home. A True Gift. I’ve been using the Amen app throughout Lent and absolutely love it. The daily readings and ability to record reflections make prayer feel personal and meaningful. The sleep meditations are wonderful, with soothing voices that help me fall asleep peacefully. I am amazed at how much content is available, especially for a free app. It has completely replaced the Halo app for me and offers just as much, if not more. I’ve already been sharing it with others and look forward to continuing to explore it.
Great app. The app is a great resource to help build, improve or maintain one’s prayer life. The daily reflections and meditations are great tools to better understand the words of God.

Love this app. I love this app. I use this app daily. It is an excellent resource and I also love the fact that, to quote (I believe) Dr. Gray, “you don’t have to pay, to pray.” I support financially when I can, however, I am on a very fixed budget which makes monthly payments impossible. Beautiful. A treasure trove of things that bring you closer to God, with prayers, Daily Mass Reading, and other things. Many options for background music or ambient noise which helps me focus. I’m grateful for this app.

Daily Readings. The daily readings and comments following are a great way to pray with the whole Church each day. Peaceful way to start your morning.
Love it. Absolutely amazing and so inspiring. Spiritual healing and uplifting empowerment to fighting the good fight of faith.

❤️‍🔥. Love this app!! I have been using it daily to help me pray the rosary as well as novenas and daily scripture readings. Easy to navigate with helpful reminder settings to keep you on track. Such a great resource.

Study it Live it and Pray it. Amen is one of the most amazing apps that I have, cost by as a practicing Catholic and someone who wants to get to know their faith more it helps me practice read it and leave it. I love that it has so many different types of prayers and when I pray, I really do feel the connection of it’s the time that I give to Jesus not just a app. It’s the time that you have with God in meditation, personally love the chaplet of the Divine Mercy! And it’s free, so what are you waiting on?
A grateful listener. Thank you for all this wonderful Catholic content for free, especially the prayers we can pray along with. It helps us to remember to reflect. God bless you.

The Amen app is an absolute blessing.. As always, the Augustine Institute has created something truly exceptional. The selection of prayers, novenas, meditations, and reflections is rich, reverent, and thoughtfully curated. Each day offers something meaningful to draw us closer to Christ.

One of the standout features is the incredible sacred art, no one does it better. It makes the app not just functional, but beautiful and inspiring.

Whether you’re looking for daily meditations, powerful novenas, or simply a quiet moment with God, Amen delivers. I couldn’t be happier with it. Highly recommended for anyone seeking to grow in their faith.

More than I thought. I’ve had the app for a while but am only now getting into the habit of opening it. There’s so much to contribute to my faith! It helps me to pray, and to learn, and both are importantly in the Catholic life.

This is awesome. I have had this app for about 6 months, have never used it, even though I get daily reminders. This morning I opened it and came across Chris Stefanik’s “one minute meditations”
I am hooked!
Great free app. Getting back into my faith and this is helping . It’s great that it’s donation based unlike other Catholic apps
New to Catholicism. Love the app, have been enjoying it. I think if I were able to read the Bible in the app that would make it perfect.

Can’t Pray Without It. I love this app!! I have hard time focusing and staying grounded, therefore, not to able to be meditate and stay in peace to pray. This app is God’s gift for people like me ✝️🙏❤️
Incredibly Profound. An absolute treasure of an app. Myriads of different prayers and meditations on our beautiful Lord Jesus Christ. God bless.

Wonderful Prayer and Reflection App. I love that they offer all these prayers, daily Bible readings, reflections and commentaries for free! We can’t all afford to pay for prayer apps. I also think the reflections for sleep and anxiety are genuinely helpful to bring peace to me each day.

Great app for simplicity and reflection. I enjoy many Catholic apps and they definitely have pros and cons. This app is absolutely perfect for reflection and embracing simplicity of life. Because images and artwork is simple and not full of text or video it helps side in prayer and reflection. I highly recommend this amazing app for your personal and family prayer and growth in the faith!
Beautiful. This app has helped me so much, it’s truly blessed, I hope other take part in this glorious mystery.
Returning Catholic. First day opening the app in about a year and I forgot how resourceful it is. Can’t wait to continue this new journey!

An oasis for my thirsty soul. I was born and raised Catholic, and like many - I strayed away from the faith and followed a Protestant path for over 40 years. So much has happened to me during that time - highs and lows. I now find myself back at home with my 92 year old mom. It is such a blessing to care for her. Truth be told she blesses me just the same. At 92 she still prays the Rosary daily. I am certain that as a result of her faithfulness, God has drawn me back “home”. I feel God’s love and presence when I pray The Rosary. This app helps and guides me with that. I cannot express how thankful I am for it.

I went back to Amen and listened to the June 21 reflections from the beginning but this time it played correctly. This is the second time this happened in my recent use of the app.
Professional. Love Amen app
New to the faith.. This app helped introduce me to the Catholic faith. I like the prayer and meditation portion of this app. My opinion is the app is top notch for people seeking to find Jesus.
The best. The amen app is not commercialized at all. The amen app. Selections are very intelligent and clear. The amen app has many varieties and the voices are beautiful that say the prayers.

Positivity. Absolutely incredible!! Thank God for this app!
